subject: Full loop — three‑phase staging plan and candidate availability (Evan Brooks)
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@gmail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Full loop — scheduling and three‑phase staging (initial)

Hi Evan —

Thanks again for taking the time to speak with us last week. We'd like to schedule the full interview loop (virtual onsite) for the Senior Platform Engineer role. We propose a three‑phase schedule to keep each panel tight and give you buffer windows between blocks:

Phase A (system design): 60 min
Phase B (deep dive + live design exercise): 90 min
Phase C (culture + exec sync): 45 min

Proposed windows (PST):
• Option 1: Thu Dec 10 — 09:00–12:00 (A/B) then 13:00–13:45 (C)
• Option 2: Fri Dec 11 — 12:00–15:00 (A/B) then 16:00–16:45 (C)

We will keep a 45 minute buffer between A/B and C to allow for a short break and system access if needed. Attachments: fullloop‑runbook‑v2.pdf (internal runbook) and your resume stub I have on file.

Can you confirm which option works best and any hard constraints (childcare, timezone travel, calendar blocks)? Also let me know if you'd like the live exercise to be a coding exercise (shared editor) or whiteboard/system design only.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Recruiter, Talent Partnering
Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com

From: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@gmail.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Full loop — scheduling and three‑phase staging (initial)

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks — Option 1 on Thu Dec 10 is preferable. I have a hard stop at 13:30 PST (previous commitment), so the Phase C window needs to finish no later than 13:30 or we should move C earlier. I prefer a whiteboard/system design exercise rather than a live coding session.

Also — small request: I have sensory sensitivity to long continuous webcam time. Could we add a 15‑minute micro‑break in the middle of the 90 minute Phase B (roughly at +45m)? That would help a lot.

Resume attached (just in case).

Best,
Evan

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Evan Brooks — adjust Phase C and add micro‑break (needs accommodation)

Team —

Quick notes from Evan (candidate):
• He can do Thu Dec 10 but must be off camera by 13:30 PST — Phase C must end by 13:30.
• Prefers whiteboard/system design, not live coding.
• Requests a 15‑minute micro‑break in the middle of Phase B.

Proposed internal adjustments (we'll send updated calendar invite to Evan once you confirm):
• Phase A: 09:00–10:00 (System design interview) — Laura (lead) + Logan
• Phase B: 10:15–11:45 (Deep dive + whiteboard) — Logan (lead) + Marissa — include 10:55–11:10 micro‑break as an explicit pause (candidate remains muted/offcam)
• Phase C (final): 12:45–13:30 (Culture + hiring manager sync) — Laura + Hiring Manager (we need to confirm David Y.)

Notes: I intentionally added a 15 minute gap 10:00–10:15 to give Evan time to grab water and to let us prepare the shared doc. The 12:45 start moves C earlier and still gives a 45 minute gap after B for any internal buffer.

Logan — can you take lead on Phase B? Marissa, please prepare the whiteboard prompt (short system scenario + 2 follow‑up bug/hardening questions). Laura — can you confirm the hiring manager availability for 12:45–13:30? If David Y is unavailable, propose an alternate HM (I can escalate).

I'll draft the updated invite and a short interviewer playbook for the panel (attachment: fullloop‑runbook‑v2.pdf).

Thanks —
Vanessa

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 15:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: Evan Brooks — adjust Phase C and add micro‑break

Ack — I can lead Phase B and will write the whiteboard prompt with Marissa. Agreed on the micro‑break at 10:55–11:10.

Laura — David Y confirmed via DM that he is tentatively available 12:45–13:30. I'll add him on the calendar once Vanessa sends the invite.

Also, small ops ask: we'll need access to the candidate's public repo for one of the followups. Vanessa — can you request a short read link (or have Evan paste the link in the pre‑interview doc)?

—Logan

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@gmail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, David Yang <david.yang@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 08:02:00 -0800
Subject: Confirmed: Thu Dec 10 — Evan Brooks virtual onsite (updated)

Hi Evan —

Thanks for the quick reply and for the accommodation note — we've adjusted the schedule and added the micro‑break. Final confirmed plan (PST):

09:00–10:00 Phase A — System design (Laura, Logan)
10:00–10:15 Prep/buffer (candidate break)
10:15–11:45 Phase B — Deep dive + whiteboard (Logan, Marissa) — micro‑break 10:55–11:10
11:45–12:45 Internal buffer / interviewer sync
12:45–13:30 Phase C — Culture + HM sync (Laura, David Yang)

I've attached the runbook and added calendar invites with links. Please RSVP on the invites — calendar description includes the whiteboard doc and a short pre‑read. If you can paste a public repo link you'd like us to glance at into the RSVP comments that would be helpful.

Accessible accommodations: we'll add a brief note to the interviewers to keep camera sensitivity in mind and to offer the option to disable video during the micro‑break.

See you Thu — let me know if anything changes.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Recruiter, Talent Partnering
Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com
